create_PBT_instance: create a PBT instance with sphere, cigar, and ellipsoid functions for population-based training
run_PBT_evolve: run the evolve method to perform gradient descent on checkpoints using hyperparameter learning rates
test_PBT_value: test the value method to compute the summed fitness of unflattened checkpoint arrays
review_PBT_itercases: review the itercases class method to iterate over predefined PBT configuration combinations
summarize_PBT_unflatten: summarize the unflatten method that splits a flat array into per-function dimension slices
